jobDescription:
Junior Fullstack Developer (Hybrid, Thessaloniki)

We are a small product team building an internal operations platform for logistics companies. You will work across the stack with two senior developers and a designer.

What you will do:
- Build features end to end in Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript
- Write and maintain REST endpoints in Node.js
- Model data in PostgreSQL and work with Prisma migrations
- Help keep our Docker-based local environment and CI pipeline healthy
- Participate in code review and pair on tricky problems

What we are looking for:
- Comfortable with React and TypeScript in a real project, not only tutorials
- Understands relational data modelling and can write SQL when the ORM is not enough
- Familiar with Git workflows and pull requests
- 0-2 years of professional experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped side projects
- Good written English; Greek is useful but not required

Nice to have: experience with real-time features (WebSockets), Tailwind CSS, deployment on Vercel or similar platforms.

We offer a defined salary range for the level, hybrid work, and a mentoring plan for the first six months.
